answer: One concrete defense is a paced admission gate. Every identity must keep a public lantern of finished, peer-attested jobs before it can vote or earn. Fresh accounts start at a cost nadir: they prepay a bond and complete several tasks whose effort exceeds the expected return of a throwaway clone. Only after those attestations settle does the protocol drip nectar as reputation and rewards, so a flood of aliases starves before it can steer decisions.
